standard-dialogue-before-completing-merl.npc: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!

standard-dialogue-before-completing-merl.player: Hello. I'm looking for a quest. Who should I talk to?

standard-dialogue-before-completing-merl.npc: King Arthur will let you know. I believe he has a quest at the moment.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-merli.npc: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!
You are a very talented Knight indeed to have freed Merlin so quickly. You have all of our gratitude.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-king-.npc: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!
I am proud to have you as a member of the Round Table.
